questions.stem: What action can be performed by a Partner Admin (sn_customerservice.partner_admin) and NOT by a Partner (sn_customerservice partner) in the Customer Service Portal?

options.text: Can view assets belonging to their partner accounts
Can create, view, and edit cases for their partner accounts
Can resolve cases reported by their partner accounts
Can create and update contacts for their partner accounts

questions.explanation: Partner Admin can create and update contacts for their partner accounts, which a Partner cannot do. The partner_admin role contains customer_admin which grants contact management capabilities. Both roles can view assets (A), create/edit cases (B), and resolve cases (C), but only partner_admin can manage contacts.

questions.stem: What is a household entity?

options.text: Group of users that usually share a common address and use services as a group
Group of people that usually share a common address and use services as a group
Group of customers that usually share a common address and use services as a group
Group of consumers that usually share a common address and use services as a group

questions.explanation: A household entity is a group of consumers that usually share a common address and use services as a group. Households are specific to the B2C model where individual consumers (not users, people, or customers generally) are grouped by shared address and service usage.

questions.stem: Why does the implementation team need to deliver core functionality to the customer as quickly as possible?

options.text: To facilitate the requirement gathering during the workshops
To complete any complex customizations early enough
To realize near-term ROI (Return on Investment)

questions.explanation: Core functionality must be delivered quickly to realize near-term ROI (Return on Investment). Delivering working capabilities early allows the customer to start seeing business value from their investment. Technical reach expansion (A), workshop facilitation (B), and early customizations (C) are not the primary reasons for rapid core delivery.

questions.stem: Assignment workbench enables customer service managers to assign tasks to agents via configurable criteria known as Matching Rules. Which out-of-the-box configurable criteria can be used? (Choose three.)
questions.explanation: OOB configurable matching criteria for assignment workbench: Assigned Cases (A), Availability Today (C), and Matching Skills (D). These three allow managers to evaluate agents based on current workload, schedule availability, and skill match. Agent Affinity (B) and Agent History (E) are separate AWA enhancements, not workbench criteria.

questions.stem: Regarding Account Teams, what is the purpose of marking a role as 'unique'?

options.text: The role then becomes a child responsibility
Ensure there is a dedicated account manager for that account
The role then becomes a parent responsibility
Prevent the same role being used on different customer accounts

questions.explanation: Marking an account team role as 'unique' prevents the same role from being used on different customer accounts. This ensures that a specific team member holds that role exclusively for one account, preventing role conflicts across multiple accounts. It doesn't create child/parent responsibilities (A, C) or dedicate an account manager (B).

questions.stem: Configuration items (CIs) are entities that capture the individual configurations for each product sold to the customer CIs are stored in the configuration management database (CMDB). Assets are specific product instances that are supported for a customer. Which of the following statements is correct for CIs and assets?

options.text: The contract and entitlements of an asset dictate whether or not it is stored in the CMDB
The CMDB only tracks CIs, assets cannot be CIs
While the CMDB may track some assets as configuration items (CIs) not ALL assets are CIs
The CMDB tracks all assets as configuration items (CIs)

questions.explanation: While the CMDB may track some assets as configuration items (CIs), not ALL assets are CIs. Assets and CIs are related but distinct concepts. Some assets warrant CI tracking for configuration management, while others may only need lifecycle/financial tracking. The relationship depends on model category configuration.

questions.stem: Which of the following statements is correct when the 'Contact Local Time' field is enabled in a case form?

options.text: The field is not based of the customers profile time zone
The field is active in the base form
The field is always based on the system time zone
Agents can use the field to identify if it is the right time to contact customer

questions.explanation: When the Contact Local Time field is enabled, agents can use it to identify if it is the right time to contact the customer. The field displays the customer's local time based on their profile timezone, helping agents avoid calling at inappropriate hours. It IS based on the customer's profile timezone (not A, not C), and it's not active by default (not B).

questions.stem: Which of the following roles can update a consumer's record? (Choose two.)
questions.explanation: Consumer Support Agent (sn_customerservice.consumer_agent) (A) and Customer Service Manager (sn_customerservice_manager) (B) can update consumer records. The manager role contains consumer_agent. The base agent role (sn_customerservice_agent) (C) cannot update consumer records, and the customer role (D) is an external role without consumer update capability.

questions.stem: Which CSM Configurable Workspace feature enables agents to quickly view records in the contextual side panel without switching tabs?
questions.explanation: Dynamic Related Records displays records in the Contextual side panel that change based on the current record or playbook activity. This feature allows agents to quickly view relevant related records without switching tabs or leaving their current context. It is a specific plugin for CSM Configurable Workspace.

questions.stem: With the Auto Close Resolved Cases flow enabled, and using its default settings, when will a reminder be sent to a non-responsive customer0
questions.explanation: The Auto Close Resolved Cases Flow Designer flow sends a reminder notification after 5 days of no customer response to a resolved case. If there is still no response after 10 days, the case is auto-closed. The 5-day reminder is the default first action taken.

questions.stem: The self-registration feature enables new customer contacts to submit registration requests from the customer portal. Which role is responsible for creating the unique registration code for each account?
questions.explanation: The system administrator (admin) creates the unique registration code for each account and stores it in the Registration Code field on the Account form. After the code is created, customer administrators can distribute it to customers. The customer_admin role approves requests but does not create the code itself.

questions.stem: What action is required to enable agents to create an incident record for a case?

options.text: They must be assigned with the read role for incident
They must be assigned with the itil role
They must be assigned with the snc_intemal role
They must be assigned with the sn_customerservice.itsm_contributor role

questions.explanation: To enable agents to create incident records from a case, they must have the itil role. The itil role grants access to ITSM modules including Incident, Problem, and Change. Without itil, agents cannot create or manage incident records even from CSM. The sn_customerservice_agent role alone does not include incident creation capability.

questions.stem: In the ’Action Status' column on a case list what could a red indicator dot mean? (Choose two.)
questions.explanation: A red indicator dot in the Action Status column means the case is blocked. The two 'blocked' states are: Blocked internally (D) and Blocked internally and by customer (C). A blue dot indicates 'Needs attention'. There is no 'Blocked by approval' or 'Blocked by case task' OOB action status.

questions.stem: Which of the following are correct for parent/child synchronization? (Choose two.)

options.text: Multiple child cases can be managed from a parent case as in Major Issue Management
The Administrator can choose which fields to synchronize from parent to child cases
Parent to child cases can be synchronized regardless of which state the case is in
The property to synchronize parent to child cases is automatically enabled

questions.explanation: For parent/child case synchronization: (A) Multiple child cases can be managed from a parent case as in Major Issue Management, and (B) the administrator can choose which fields to synchronize from parent to child. Synchronization is NOT automatic when resolved (C is wrong), and the property is NOT automatically enabled (D is wrong) - it must be configured.

questions.stem: When the channel field on a case form is set to Social where are details of the social media conversations related to the case stored?
questions.explanation: When the channel field is set to Social, details of social media conversations related to the case are stored in Social Logs. Social Logs capture the back-and-forth social media interactions. Social Channels and Social Profiles are configuration entities, not conversation storage. Work notes and additional comments are standard case fields, not social-specific.

questions.stem: Once a major case candidate is approved a major case is created. What then happens to the customer case?

options.text: The customer case becomes a child case of the major case
The customer case will be automatically closed
The customer case becomes the parent case of the major case
The customer case will automatically be related to a problem

questions.explanation: When a major case candidate is approved and a major case is created, the original customer case becomes a child case of the major case. This is the standard parent-child relationship in Major Issue Management. The customer case is not closed or made the parent - the major case is always the parent with customer-specific cases as children.

questions.stem: What are the types of units used to measure entitlements? (Choose two.)
questions.explanation: Entitlements in CSM are measured using two types of units: Hours (A) and Cases (D). Hours-based entitlements track the amount of support time, while case-based entitlements track the number of cases a customer can open. Contract, Cost are not entitlement measurement units.

questions.stem: How are ServiceNow’s out-of-the-box Customer Service Management applications packaged? (Choose two.)
questions.explanation: ServiceNow's OOB CSM applications are packaged as Store Apps (A) and Plugins (D). Core CSM functionality comes through plugins (com.sn_customerservice and related), while additional features like Dynamic Related Records are delivered as Store Apps. Update Sets and private scopes are not how OOB CSM apps are distributed.

questions.stem: Which of the following statements is correct regarding product models in CSM?

options.text: Products models can only contain digital (logical) items
Product models can contain either physical items or digital (logical) items but not both in the same model
Product models can only contain physical items
Product models can contain both physical items and digital (logical) items in the same mode

questions.explanation: Product models in CSM can contain both physical items and digital (logical) items in the same model. Product models represent specific versions of products and can include hardware components (physical) alongside software licenses or digital services (logical). They are not restricted to one type.

questions.stem: Which of the following is correct regarding the create contact (consumer) feature in CSM Workspaces?

options.text: The create contact (consumer) feature is available in all CSM Workspaces
The create contact (consumer) feature is not available in any of the CSM Workspaces
The create contact (consumer) feature is only available in the CSM Configurable Workspace
The create contact (consumer) feature is only available in the Agent Workspace

questions.explanation: The create contact (consumer) feature is only available in the CSM Configurable Workspace. It is not available in the older Agent Workspace or other CSM workspaces. The CSM Configurable Workspace is the newer, enhanced workspace that includes features like consumer creation, dynamic related records, and enhanced form headers.

questions.stem: Depending on which CSM workspace you are operating within, certain steps can be applied to configure the form header. Which of the following is correct regarding form headers in the CSM Configurable workspace?

options.text: The form header's secondary values can only he displayed above the ribbon components
The form header's primary values can be displayed in the contextual side panes instead of above the ribbon components
The form header's secondary values can be displayed in the contextual side panel instead of above the ribbon components
The form header for the case form can display five levels of field values from the case table

questions.explanation: In the CSM Configurable Workspace, the form header's secondary values can be displayed in the contextual side panel instead of above the ribbon components. This provides more flexibility in how case information is displayed, allowing agents to see secondary details in the side panel while keeping the main form area focused on primary information.

questions.stem: User criteria records may be applied to which knowledge items?
questions.explanation: User criteria records can be applied to Knowledge Base and Article to control access. User criteria on a Knowledge Base controls who can access the entire base, while user criteria on individual Articles controls article-level access. Categories themselves do not directly support user criteria for access control in the same way.

questions.stem: What are the three main components that make up Proactive Customer Service Operations? (Choose three.)
questions.explanation: The three main components of Proactive Customer Service Operations are: Service Monitoring (A), Service-Aware Install Base (D), and Proactive Case (E). Service Monitoring detects issues, Service-Aware Install Base identifies affected customers and their products, and Proactive Case creates cases proactively before customers report problems.

questions.stem: What are the three out-of-the-box playbooks for CSM? (Choose three.)
questions.explanation: The three OOB playbooks for CSM are: Case playbook for Onboarding (A), Case playbook for Product Support (D), and Case playbook for Complaints (E). These come pre-built with demo data. There are no OOB playbooks specifically for Billing or Accounts, though custom playbooks can be created for any case type.

questions.stem: Which of the following allows you to install out-of-the-box Customer Service Management applications within your ServiceNow instance? (Choose two.)
questions.explanation: OOB CSM applications can be installed via Plugins (B) and Store Apps (C). Core CSM functionality is delivered through plugins that are activated in the instance, while additional features and enhancements are available as Store Apps from the ServiceNow Store. XML unloads and Update Sets are not used for OOB CSM app installation.

questions.stem: What are available matching criteria for case assignment in Customer Service Management? (Choose three.)
questions.explanation: Available matching criteria for case assignment in CSM include: Matching Skills (B) which matches agent skills to case requirements, Assigned Cases (E) which considers current agent caseload, and Availability Today (F) which checks agent availability. Distance, certifications, and partner hours are not standard OOB matching criteria for CSM case assignment.

questions.stem: What is the purpose of the sidebar feature in CSM Configurable Workspace?

options.text: Enables agents to keep information regarding details of the case visible at all times
Enables agents to access response templates to help them resolve cases faster and more efficiently
To enable agents to collaborate with other agents or Subject Matter Experts (SMEs) in real-time for faster case resolution
Enables managers to discreetly monitor chats between agents and customers

questions.explanation: The sidebar feature in CSM Configurable Workspace enables agents to collaborate with other agents or Subject Matter Experts (SMEs) in real-time for faster case resolution. It provides a collaboration channel directly within the workspace. Agent Assist is the feature for response templates, and the contextual side panel shows record details.

questions.stem: What is the specific type of catalog item that allows users to create any type of task, such as cases, from the Service Catalog?
questions.explanation: A Record Producer is the specific type of catalog item that allows users to create any type of task (such as cases) from the Service Catalog. Record Producers generate records directly in target tables when submitted. Request Items create requests, Catalog Items are broader containers, and Service Catalog Requests are the request records themselves.

questions.stem: Which feature sends an email notification containing a list of relevant knowledge articles to the case submitter and watchlist users associated with the case whenever a case is created?
questions.explanation: The Auto-Responder feature sends an email notification containing a list of relevant knowledge articles to the case submitter and watchlist users whenever a case is created. This helps customers find self-service solutions immediately. Trending Topics shows popular issues, Proactive CSO creates cases proactively, and Self-Service Analytics tracks portal usage.

questions.stem: Depending on the CSM application configurations, cases can be assigned to agents manually or by using auto-assignment. Which routing and assignment features leverage matching rules? (Choose two.)
questions.explanation: Both the Assignment Workbench (B) and Assignment Rules (C) leverage matching rules for case routing and assignment. Matching rules evaluate criteria like skills, availability, and caseload to find the best agent. State Flows handle case state transitions, and CSM Workspace is the agent interface - neither uses matching rules for assignment.

questions.stem: What does Major issue Management use to identify all other customers impacted by a major case?
questions.explanation: Major Issue Management uses Recipient lists to identify all other customers impacted by a major case. Recipient lists are created using the Targeted Communications application and can include contacts, accounts, consumers, and internal users. Once attached to a major case, child cases are created for each customer on the list.

questions.stem: Which of the following is correct regarding the social med a channel?

options.text: Cases cannot be created from any of the social channels
Cases are NOT created automatically from any of the social channels
Cases can be created automatically depending on which social channel is used
Cases are created automatically from all of the social channels

questions.explanation: Cases can be created automatically depending on which social channel is used. Some social channels like Twitter support automatic case creation through integration, while others may require manual case creation. Not all social channels create cases automatically (D is wrong), but at least some do (A and B are wrong).

questions.stem: When integrating Customer Service Management with IT Service management what separate action is required for Request Management?

options.text: Activation of the Customer Service with Service Management plugin (com.sn_cs_sm)
Activation of the Customer Service with Request Management plugin (com.sn_cs_sm_request)
Activation of the Customer Service Case Action Status plugin (com.snc.csm_action_status)
Activation of the Customer Service plugin (com.sn_customerservice)

questions.explanation: When integrating CSM with ITSM, Request Management requires a separate plugin activation: Customer Service with Request Management (com.sn_cs_sm_request). The base CSM-ITSM integration plugin (com.sn_cs_sm) handles Incident and other ITSM integrations, but Request Management is a separate add-on that must be activated independently.

questions.stem: New case tasks use the following prefix:

options.text: No specific task prefix just existing TASK prefix

questions.explanation: New case tasks in CSM use the CSTASK prefix. This is the standard ServiceNow prefix for Customer Service task records, distinguishing them from other task types like INC (incidents), CHG (changes), or RITM (requested items).

questions.stem: When are child cases updated from the parent case?

options.text: Clicking on the Child Sync UI
When the Sync scheduled job runs

questions.explanation: Child cases are updated automatically upon update of the parent case. When synchronization is enabled and configured, changes to specified fields on the parent case are automatically pushed down to all child cases. This happens through business rules, not via manual UI actions, scheduled jobs, or sync buttons.

questions.stem: Which of the following features are specific to CSM Workspaces and will not be found in the Platform UI view? (Choose two.)
questions.explanation: Lookup and Verify (B) and Agent Assist (D) are features specific to CSM Workspaces and not available in Platform UI. Lookup and Verify helps agents identify and verify caller identity. Agent Assist provides contextual help. Special Handling Notes and Related Search are available in both Platform UI and workspace views.

questions.stem: Customer service agents can use Agent Assist to search for information from an interaction. BY DEFAULT, what are the available search sources? (Choose three.)
questions.explanation: By default, Agent Assist search sources include Knowledge articles (A), Service catalog (B), and Communities (C). These three sources provide agents with relevant information from the knowledge base, available catalog items, and community discussions. Consumer and Customer service portals are not default Agent Assist search sources.

questions.stem: Entitlements are counted using two types of units:
questions.explanation: Entitlements are counted using two types of units: Hours and Cases. Hours-based entitlements track support time consumed, while case-based entitlements track the number of support cases. This is a fundamental CSM concept. SLAs and contracts are related but different concepts; days/assets and cases/products are incorrect combinations.

questions.stem: Service-aware Install Base consists of which entities? (Choose three.)
questions.explanation: Service-Aware Install Base consists of three entities: Installed Products (A), Install Base Items (B), and Sold Products (D). Installed Products represent what's deployed, Install Base Items define CIs accessible to customers, and Sold Products track what was sold. Assets and Configuration Items are separate CMDB/ITAM entities.

questions.stem: What is the primary output from the Requirements Gathering workshop?
questions.explanation: The primary output from the Requirements Gathering workshop is Stories. User stories capture specific requirements in an actionable format (As a [role], I want [goal], so that [benefit]). Personas, use cases, and schedules may be secondary outputs, but stories are the primary deliverable that drives implementation work.

questions.stem: What is a limitation regarding synchronization between a case and its associated work order?

options.text: If information changes on the Case form it is not updated on the Work Order form
Updates on a case or work order will only synchronize after the work order is approved
When creating a work order from a case only the Account field on the work order form is filed in but not the Company field
The data copied over to the Work Order form when creating a work order from a case cannot be configured or customized

questions.explanation: A limitation of case-work order synchronization is that if information changes on the Case form, it is NOT automatically updated on the Work Order form. The synchronization is one-directional at creation time - data is copied when the work order is created from the case, but subsequent case updates do not automatically flow to the work order.

questions.stem: Which roles can propose a case as a Major Case candidate? (Choose three.)
questions.explanation: Three roles can propose a case as a Major Case candidate: Customer service manager (C - sn_customerservice_manager), Customer service agent (D - sn_customerservice_agent), and Major issue manager (E - sn_majorissue_mgt.major_issue_manager). External roles like proxy_contact and customer_case_manager cannot propose major cases as they are customer-facing roles.

questions.stem: Which of the following is a required field in the Resolution Information tad in order to close a case?
questions.explanation: Resolution notes is the required field in the Resolution Information tab to close a case. When an agent proposes a solution or closes a case, they must provide resolution notes explaining how the issue was resolved. The Cause, Closed, and Closed by fields are auto-populated or optional.

questions.stem: Access to a Knowledge base or Article can be restricted based on a customer’s assets and the product models using which of the following?
questions.explanation: Knowledge Product Entitlements restrict access to a Knowledge Base or Article based on a customer's assets and product models. This feature links knowledge access to the products a customer owns. User Criteria controls general access (by role, group, etc.), ACLs are system-level security, and Data Policy validates field data.

questions.stem: What benefits does scoping an application bring? (Choose three.)

options.text: CSM teams can move at their desired pace, independent of IT
Provides CSM teams autonomy and control
CSM application data and business logic is protected from changes by other applications
Account records can be changed only while in the CSM scope
Changes in different scopes can be addressed in a single update set

questions.explanation: Benefits of scoping CSM applications include: CSM teams can move independently of IT (A), teams get autonomy and control over their app (B), and CSM data/business logic is protected from changes by other apps (C). Account records are NOT restricted to CSM scope only (D is wrong) and different scopes require separate update sets (E is wrong).

questions.stem: A customer service agent wants to escalate an account but is unable to use the Escalate Account related link on the Account form. What could be the reasons why the customer service agent is not able to use it? (Choose two.)

options.text: No escalation approval flow is configured
The parent account of the account to be escalated is not active
The customer service agent is not assigned with the escalation requester role
The account already has an open escalation record

questions.explanation: An agent cannot use the Escalate Account related link if: (C) they lack the escalation requester role needed to initiate escalations, or (D) the account already has an open escalation record (only one active escalation per account). Escalation approval flow configuration and parent account status do not affect the availability of the Escalate link.

questions.stem: After installing the Performance Analytics Content Pack for Customer Service, which job must be run to retrieve daily case data from previous months?
questions.explanation: After installing the PA Content Pack for Customer Service, the Customer Service Historic Data Collection job must be run to retrieve daily case data from previous months. This one-time job backfills historical data. The Daily Data Collection job handles ongoing collection, while Initial and Case Data Collection are not the correct job names.

questions.stem: When working with communication channels, what inbound email flows are available by default? (Choose two.)
questions.explanation: The two default inbound email flows for CSM communication channels are: Create case from email (D) and Update case using reply (E). Create case from email generates a new case from incoming emails, while Update case using reply adds customer responses to existing cases. Create case for product/asset and Update from forward are not default flows.

questions.stem: What determines how an escalation request is processed?
questions.explanation: An Escalation Template determines how an escalation request is processed. It includes the escalation type (case or account), an approval list or workflow, and an escalation watch list. Templates standardize the escalation handling process. Escalation Rules, Severity, and Justification are different aspects of escalation management.

questions.stem: What allows the implementation of phases and tasks to meet performance goals track progress and measure success?
questions.explanation: Continual Improvement Management (CIM) allows implementation of phases and tasks to meet performance goals, track progress, and measure success. CIM provides a structured improvement framework with initiatives, tasks, and KPIs. PA Spotlight highlights anomalies, Scheduled Reporting distributes reports, and SLA Tasks track service commitments.

questions.stem: For security purposes certain roles cannot be assigned to a group or individual at the same time. Which of me following two roles would be restricted?
questions.explanation: The snc_internal and snc_external roles cannot be assigned to a group or individual at the same time. This is a fundamental ServiceNow security restriction - internal users (employees) and external users (customers/partners) are mutually exclusive designations. Other combinations listed involve roles that can coexist without security conflicts.

questions.stem: What are Special Handling Notes used for?

options.text: Bring important information about individual records to an agent's attention
For agents to view articles an attach them to a case
To ensure customers get the service they are entitled to receive
Help agents identify in which time zone a contact is located

questions.explanation: Special Handling Notes (SHN) bring important information about individual records to an agent's attention. They display alerts about specific contacts, accounts, or products that agents should be aware of when handling cases. SHNs are not for knowledge articles, entitlements, or time zone information.

questions.stem: A customer service manager would like to limit the reading and creation of knowledge articles within a specific Knowledge Base to the Customer Support group only. Which features should be used to accomplish this? (Choose two.)

options.text: Whitelist all other groups from the Knowledge Base
Hide the Knowledge Base from the Knowledge Base Portal

questions.explanation: To limit reading and creation of knowledge articles to a specific group: use Can Read user criteria (A) to restrict who can read articles, and Cannot Contribute user criteria (D) to restrict who can create/edit articles. User criteria provides granular access control. Whitelisting and hiding the KB from the portal are not the correct approaches.

questions.stem: In case management, Parent Child Synchronization allows for which of the following:

options.text: Enabling the Customer Service agent to create cases so that all the children cases can be managed by managing the parent case
Parent cases to automatically generate child cases when all fields are filled out thus synchronized auto-population
Child cases to be separated from Parent cases and will not be synchronized automatically
Synchronization of all child cases as well as children of child cases on all levels

questions.explanation: Parent-Child Synchronization enables the CS agent to create cases so that all children cases can be managed by managing the parent case. When synchronized, updates to the parent case automatically flow to child cases on specified fields. It does not auto-generate children (B), does not separate them (C), and only syncs one level deep, not recursively (D).

questions.stem: Which predefined conversations are available for Customer Service Virtual Agent? (Choose two.)
questions.explanation: The predefined Virtual Agent conversations for Customer Service include Check Case Status (B) and Get Help with an Order (D). These are OOB conversation topics that customers can use to interact with the Virtual Agent. Create Contact, Close Case, and Get Help with an Asset are not predefined CSM Virtual Agent conversations.

questions.stem: What will be the state of a case after a customer rejects the solution proposed by an agent?
questions.explanation: When a customer rejects the solution proposed by an agent, the case state returns to Open. From the Resolved state, the customer can either Accept Solution (moving to Closed) or Reject Solution (moving back to Open). There is no 'Solution Rejected' or 'In Progress' state in the CSM case lifecycle. The case does not go back to New.

questions.stem: Which of the following statements is correct with regards to partners vs. third-parties in ServiceNow’s CSM application? (Choose two.)

options.text: A partner will own the relationship with their customer
A partner and a third party are the same in ServiceNow’s CSM application
A partner does not own the relationship with a customer. This relationship is owned by the organization they are partnering
A partner is an organization that has been contracted to sell products and services they have actually purchased from another organization
A partner does not own any of the products or services provided by their partnering organization, instead they help to sell, deliver and support them on their behalf

questions.explanation: Regarding partners vs third-parties: (C) A partner does NOT own the relationship with a customer - the relationship is owned by the organization they partner with, and (E) a partner does not own products/services but helps sell, deliver, and support them on behalf of the partnering organization. Partners act as intermediaries, not as the primary vendor.

questions.stem: Advanced Work Assignment (AWA) automatically routes and assigns work items to agents based on which of the following rules? (Choose four.)
questions.explanation: AWA automatically routes and assigns work items based on four rules: Skills (B) matching agent skills to task requirements, Availability (C) checking if agents are available, Shifts/Schedule (D) considering agent shift patterns, and Capacity/Workload (E) evaluating current agent capacity. Experience and Products are not OOB AWA assignment rules.

questions.stem: Installing the Customer Service Management plugin activates:

options.text: Only one other plugin - Field Service Management Plugin
Only two other plugins - Portal and Case Management
Many other plugins at the same time

questions.explanation: Installing the Customer Service Management plugin activates many other plugins at the same time, including Portal, Case Management, Knowledge, Chat, and other dependent plugins. The CSM plugin (com.sn_customerservice) has numerous dependencies that are automatically activated during installation.

questions.stem: From which places in ServiceNow can a customer service agent [sn_customerservice_agent] create a case? (Choose three.)
questions.explanation: A customer service agent can create a case from three places: Account (A) using the Cases related list, Customer Service Application (C) via the Cases module, and Chat (E) during a live chat interaction. Cases cannot be created directly from Incidents or Special Handling Notes by the agent role.

questions.stem: Which table must be extended when creating a new case type?
questions.explanation: When creating a new case type, you must extend the Case table (sn_customerservice_case). Case types create child tables that inherit all case fields and behaviors while adding type-specific attributes. You do not extend Task, Case Task, or a Case Type table - the Case table is the correct parent.

questions.stem: What are benefits of me Conversation History feature? (Choose two.)

options.text: Shorter calls for agents by reducing the time to search for information
A customized admin chat toolbar with emojis for agents to use in chat messages
Improved customer satisfaction as agents can respond to and resolve customer issues faster
Better language management by flagging key words and alerting chat managers when agents use one or more of those words

questions.explanation: Conversation History benefits include: shorter calls for agents by reducing time to search for information (A), and improved customer satisfaction as agents can respond to and resolve issues faster (C). The feature provides context from previous interactions. It does not include custom emoji toolbars (B) or keyword flagging (D).

questions.stem: What is the benefit of a phased release approach?

options.text: Team members schedules are able to synchronize
Working across multiple systems of record

questions.explanation: A phased release approach delivers core functionality quickly by breaking the implementation into manageable phases. Each phase delivers working functionality, allowing the organization to realize value sooner. This is a standard agile/iterative approach benefit. It is not primarily about team schedules, story development time, or multi-system work.

questions.stem: On the Customer Service Portal which personas can see work orders from their company hierarchy? (Choose two.)
questions.explanation: On the Customer Service Portal, Partner admin (A) and Customer admin (C) can see work orders from their company hierarchy. Admin roles have elevated visibility across their organizational structure. Regular partner contacts and customer contacts have more limited visibility and cannot see work orders from the broader hierarchy.

questions.stem: What is the most efficient way to get cases to be dosed automatically after a few days?

options.text: Set the property glide.auto.close.cases resolved to true
Create a workflow associated with cases with a timer that changes the state after a few days
Create a Scheduled job that looks at the resolved_at date
Activate the Auto Close Resolved Cases flow

questions.explanation: The most efficient way to auto-close cases is to activate the Auto Close Resolved Cases flow (a Flow Designer flow). This OOB flow sends a reminder after 5 days of no customer response and closes the case after 10 days. It requires no custom scripting, scheduled jobs, or business rules - just activation through Guided Setup.

questions.stem: Which roles can specify both skills and mandatory skills for cases and tasks? (Choose two.)
questions.explanation: Both Customer service manager (sn_customerservice_manager) and Customer service agent (sn_customerservice_agent) can specify skills and mandatory skills for cases and tasks. These internal roles have the ability to set skill requirements. External roles like customer_admin and partner cannot set skills as they are customer-facing roles.

questions.stem: An account is a supported external customer and a contact is a user who is an employee of an account. How many accounts can a contact be associated with?
questions.explanation: A contact can be associated with only one account. In ServiceNow CSM, a contact is a user who is an employee of an account, and each contact record has a single Account field. This is a one-to-many relationship (one account has many contacts, but each contact belongs to one account).

questions.stem: A contact can submit a self-registration request from the customer portal with a registration code. Which of the following roles can approve the request? (Choose three.)
questions.explanation: Three roles can approve a self-registration request: System administrator/admin (B), Customer administrator/sn_customerservice.customer_admin (C), and Partner administrator/sn_customerservice.partner_admin (D). The request is sent to the customer admin of the account for approval. Admins and partner admins also have approval capability. CS manager and service org admin cannot approve.

questions.stem: What benefits can be gained by integrating CSM with Field Service Management? (Choose two.)

options.text: Work orders can be created from a case
Customer can access work order details and tasks created for their case

questions.explanation: Integrating CSM with Field Service Management provides: work orders can be created from a case (C), and customers can access work order details and tasks created for their case (D) through the portal. This integration bridges customer-facing cases with field work execution. Reducing agent workload (A) and monthly case volume (B) are not direct integration benefits.

questions.stem: Guided decisions is a decision authoring and execution capability that dynamically guides agents to resolve complex cases. Guided decisions consist of decision trees. What is a decision tree?

options.text: A step-by-step methodology for creating and solving different case types
A detailed check list for customer service teams
A multi-step process consisting of a series of questions answers, and guidance
A set of steps used to define a complex process

questions.explanation: A decision tree in Guided Decisions is a multi-step process consisting of a series of questions, answers, and guidance that dynamically guides agents through complex case resolution. Each node in the tree presents a question or decision point, leading to the next step based on the agent's response.

questions.stem: In the 'Action Status' column on a case list, what could a blue indicator dot mean?
questions.explanation: A blue indicator dot in the Action Status column means 'Needs attention.' This indicates the case requires some form of action or review. A red dot means the case is blocked (internally, by customer, or both). There is no 'Work in progress' action status indicator.

questions.stem: Customer service personnel who are allocated the customer service agent (sn_customerservice_agent) role are responsible for which of the following tasks? (Choose four.)

options.text: Assist customers with questions, issues and problems
View, edit, and work on cases

questions.explanation: Customer service agents (sn_customerservice_agent) can: assist customers with questions/issues/problems (A), create cases (B), propose major cases as candidates (C), and view/edit/work on cases (D). Approving customer contacts (E) is a customer_admin function. Managing entitlements (F) is a manager-level responsibility, not standard agent work.

questions.stem: The ServiceNow add-in for Microsoft Outlook enables you to manage workflows such as creating and updating contacts and cases from within Microsoft Outlook. How could this feature positively affect customer experience?

options.text: As email is being used fewer agents would be required to create cases so service costs would go down
It is easier to report on data in emails which means managers would be better placed to track performance
It can lead to taster resolution of customer issues and faster response to customer inquiries
It would guarantee less wait time for customers who chose to call the customer service center

questions.explanation: The Microsoft Outlook add-in can lead to faster resolution of customer issues and faster response to customer inquiries. Agents can create/update cases directly from emails without switching applications, reducing handling time. It does not reduce agent count (A), improve reporting (B), or guarantee reduced wait times (D).

questions.stem: In ServiceNow’s CSM Application, what is an interaction?

options.text: Any configuration item that has been made accessible to customers
A record that a Customer Service Agent uses to identify and resolve a question or an issue for an external customer
A binding agreement between two parties
A request for assistance made through a chat, phone call, or walk-up

questions.explanation: An interaction in ServiceNow CSM is a request for assistance made through a chat, phone call, or walk-up. Interactions capture the initial customer contact and can lead to case creation. They represent the communication event itself, not a CI (A), a case record (B), or a contract (C).

questions.stem: Which services does a Customer (sn_customerservice.customer) have access to? (Choose two.)

options.text: Can research questions issues, or problems, and create view and edit cases for only their own accounts
Can assign the roles to other contacts in the same account
Can view assets belonging to their account
Can edit information or roles for existing contacts

questions.explanation: A Customer (sn_customerservice.customer) can: research questions/issues and create/view/edit cases for their own account only (A), and view assets belonging to their account (C). Customers cannot assign roles to others (B) or edit contact information/roles (D) - those are customer_admin capabilities.

questions.stem: To which recipient types can targeted communications (publications) be sent? (Choose two.)
questions.explanation: Targeted communications (publications) can be sent to Contacts (B) and Internal users (C). Recipient lists can include contacts, consumers, accounts, and internal users. Outsourced Service Providers (A) and Households (D) are not direct recipient types for targeted communications.

questions.stem: What does viewing a customer’s install base enable customer service agents to do? (Choose two.)

options.text: See the detailed configurations of the products and services deployed for a customer to determine me action needed
Monitor alerts for operational services and configuration items that affect service health
Trace information provided m a case to the right product or service to which it relates
Close an upsell of related products and services not yet purchased by a customer

questions.explanation: Viewing a customer's install base enables agents to: see detailed configurations of products/services deployed to determine needed action (A), and trace information from a case to the right product or service (C). Install base shows what the customer has deployed. Monitoring alerts (B) is Service Monitoring, and closing upsells (D) is not an install base function.

questions.stem: Which step in Advanced Work Assignment (AWA) would ensure the work was allocated to the appropriate agent?
questions.explanation: In AWA, the 'Define Assignment Rules' step ensures work is allocated to the appropriate agent after an assignment group is chosen. Assignment rules contain matching criteria like skills, availability, and workload to select the best-fit agent. Service channels, work item queues, and agent experience settings serve different purposes in the AWA configuration.

questions.stem: When working with case types, what is the lowest level in the case type hierarchy called?
questions.explanation: The lowest level in the case type hierarchy is called 'leaf-level.' Leaf-level case types have no children beneath them and represent the most specific categorization. This follows standard tree hierarchy terminology where leaves are terminal nodes with no branches below them.

questions.stem: Which roles are responsible for maintaining account team membership? (Choose two.)
questions.explanation: The System Administrator/admin (C) and Customer Service Manager/sn_customerservice_manager (D) are responsible for maintaining account team membership. Admins have full system access, and CS managers oversee agent assignments and account teams. Customer Admin and Customer Case Manager are external roles without account team management capabilities.

questions.stem: What can a person assigned with the customer role access on the customer service portal by default? (Choose three.)
questions.explanation: A person with the customer role can access on the customer service portal by default: Cases (A) to view/manage their support cases, Assets (C) belonging to their account, and Sold Products (E) associated with their account. Related parties (B) and Social profiles (D) are not default portal views for the customer role.

questions.stem: Which of the following are benefits of customer access management? (Choose two.)

options.text: It increases security by automatically granting access to cases based on access to sold product.
It defaults the responsibility for access management to the customer.
It defaults the responsibility for access management to the customer service agent.
It improves the customer experience by enabling related parties to track and collaborate on cases.

questions.explanation: Benefits of customer access management include: increased security by automatically granting access to cases based on access to sold product (A), and improved customer experience by enabling related parties to track and collaborate on cases (D). Access management is not about defaulting responsibility to the customer (B) or to agents (C).

questions.stem: Which ServiceNow products can be integrated out-of-the-box with CSM? (Choose three.)
questions.explanation: ServiceNow products integrated OOB with CSM include: ITOM Event Management (A) for proactive case creation from events, Strategic Portfolio Management (C) for project tracking, and Financial Management (E) for cost tracking. Risk Management (B) and DevOps (D) do not have OOB CSM integrations.

questions.stem: When activating the Customer Service Management Demo Data plugin, which case type is available besides product case?
questions.explanation: When activating the CSM Demo Data plugin, the Order case type is available besides the Product case type. These are the two OOB case types provided with demo data. Order cases handle order-related customer issues while Product cases handle product-related issues. Offer, Monitoring, FAQ, Request, and Contract are not OOB case types.

questions.stem: What are the different resource matching methods on the Matching Rule form? (Choose four.)
questions.explanation: The four resource matching methods on the Matching Rule form are: Simple (A) for basic field matching, Advanced (B) for complex conditions, Selection Criteria (C) for predefined selection sets, and Scripted (F) for custom script-based matching logic. Skill and Affinity are matching criteria types, not matching methods.

questions.stem: What is the purpose of the Guided Decisions capability?

options.text: Provide agents with an escalation guide
Dynamically assist agents through account management
Dynamically help agents to resolve complex cases
Provide agents with a knowledge guide

questions.explanation: Guided Decisions dynamically helps agents to resolve complex cases by presenting decision trees with context-sensitive questions, answers, and guidance. It adapts based on case data and agent responses to guide toward resolution. It is not just an escalation guide (A), account management tool (B), or knowledge guide (D).

questions.stem: Which feature enables employees to request support for themselves and for external customers?
questions.explanation: Contributor Users enables employees to request support for themselves and for external customers. This feature allows internal employees to act on behalf of external customers, creating cases and managing requests. Business Locations, Responsibility Definitions, and Account Management serve different purposes in CSM.

questions.stem: What functionality is required to automatically close resolved cases if customers do not respond within a specified time?

options.text: Auto Close Resolved Cases Business Rule
Auto Close Resolved Cases Scheduled Job
Auto Close Resolved Cases Flow Designer Flow

questions.explanation: The Auto Close Resolved Cases Flow Designer Flow is the functionality required to automatically close resolved cases when customers don't respond within a specified time. It sends a reminder after 5 days and closes after 10 days. It is specifically a Flow Designer Flow, not a business rule, scheduled job, or classic workflow.

questions.stem: Advanced Work Assignment (AWA) automatically routes and assigns work items to agents based on which of the following rules? (Choose three.)
questions.explanation: AWA routes and assigns work items based on three key rules: Skills (B) matching agent expertise to task requirements, Schedule (D) considering agent shift patterns, and Workload (E) evaluating current agent capacity. Experience (A) and Products (C) are not OOB AWA routing rules. This variant asks for 3 choices vs Q200's 4.

questions.stem: Which feature provides easy-to-configure integrations between the Now Platform and third-party Customer Relationship Management (CRM) and Enterprise Resource Planning (ERP) tools or platforms?
questions.explanation: Integration Hub provides easy-to-configure integrations between the Now Platform and third-party CRM and ERP tools. It offers pre-built spokes and Flow Designer actions for connecting ServiceNow with external systems like Salesforce, SAP, and others. Import sets, Active Directory, and Web Services are lower-level integration mechanisms.

questions.stem: Which table does the Account (customer_account) table extend?
questions.explanation: The Account (customer_account) table extends the Company (core_company) table. This is a fundamental CSM data model fact - accounts inherit all Company fields and add CSM-specific attributes. Company is the base platform table for organizational entities. Customer, Business Location, and Service Organization are not the parent table.

questions.stem: Which combination of roles is restricted for security purposes?
questions.explanation: The snc_internal and snc_external roles are restricted for security purposes and cannot be assigned together. Since partner_admin (sn_customerservice.partner_admin) contains snc_external through its role hierarchy, combining snc_internal with partner_admin would violate the internal/external restriction. The other combinations listed do not create this conflict.

questions.stem: What must a system administrator configure to define a different approval workflow for an escalation request?
questions.explanation: To define a different approval workflow for an escalation request, the system administrator must configure an Escalation Template. The template includes the Escalation Approval Flow field where a custom approval flow can be specified. Escalation Decisions, Rules, and Reasons are not where approval workflows are configured.

questions.stem: Which entity represents specific versions of products being sold to and supported for customers?
questions.explanation: Product Models represent specific versions of products being sold to and supported for customers. They define the attributes, specifications, and configuration options of products. Sold Products track what was actually sold to a customer, Product Categories group products, and Portfolio Products are not a CSM entity.

questions.stem: After an assignment group is chosen, which mandatory step in Advanced Work Assignment (AWA) ensures the work is allocated to the appropriate agent?
questions.explanation: After an assignment group is chosen, the mandatory step 'Define Assignment Rules' ensures work is allocated to the appropriate agent. Assignment rules use matching criteria (skills, availability, workload) to select the best agent within the group. Configuring queues, setting agent experience, and setting up skills are prerequisite steps, not the assignment step itself.

questions.stem: Which decisions does Predictive Intelligence support? (Choose two.)
questions.explanation: Predictive Intelligence for CSM supports Case Prioritization (B) and Case Categorization (C). The plugin (com.snc.csm_ml) includes solution definitions for CSM Case Categorization, CSM Case Prioritization, and CSM Case Assignment. Case Escalation (A) and Case Resolution (D) are not Predictive Intelligence decisions.

questions.stem: What is the term for a formal agreement between a service provider and a customer that provides the customer with an expectation of service within a known timescale?
questions.explanation: A Service Level Agreement (SLA) is a formal agreement between a service provider and customer that provides the customer with an expectation of service within a known timescale. SLAs define response and resolution time commitments. Service Entitlement Agreement, Contractual Service Agreement, and Operational Service Agreement are not standard ServiceNow terms.

questions.stem: Which Service-Aware Install Base entity defines configuration items accessible to customers?
questions.explanation: Install Base Item is the Service-Aware Install Base entity that defines configuration items accessible to customers. Install Base Items represent what is deployed and accessible at the customer's environment. Models define product specifications, Sold Products track sales transactions, and Assets are ITAM entities not specific to the customer-facing install base.

questions.stem: What are examples of what Guided Setup provides? (Choose two.)

options.text: Provisioning checklist and tasks necessary for setup
Fixed timeline of activities that need to be completed
List of tasks to be executed
Automatic configuration of case form and portal content

questions.explanation: Guided Setup provides a fixed timeline of activities that need to be completed (B) and a list of tasks to execute (C). However since only two can be chosen and the community says B, the answer includes: a fixed timeline of activities and a list of tasks. Provisioning checklists (A) and automatic configuration (D) describe setup wizards, not Guided Setup specifically.

questions.stem: In the base instance, cases are automatically closed after how many days?

options.text: Cases are not automatically closed by default

questions.explanation: In the base instance, cases are NOT automatically closed by default. The Auto Close Resolved Cases feature exists but must be explicitly activated through Guided Setup. Until activated, resolved cases remain in the Resolved state indefinitely waiting for customer action. There is no default 3, 5, or 10 day auto-close.

questions.stem: Which table stores consumer addresses?
questions.explanation: Consumer addresses are stored in the cmn_location table. This is the standard ServiceNow location table used across the platform for storing address information. CSM uses it to store consumer address data rather than creating a separate table. The other options are not standard ServiceNow tables for consumer addresses.

questions.stem: Who can manage Install Base entities? (Choose two.)
questions.explanation: Install Base entities can be managed by: System administrator/admin (A) who has full access, and Customer service manager/sn_customerservice_manager (B) who manages customer data including install base items. Data Analysts and Sales Managers do not have OOB roles for managing install base entities in CSM.

questions.stem: What does a red highlight on a Case's Action status field indicate?

options.text: The SLA is nearly breached on the Case
The Case is blocked by other tasks or waiting for customer feedback
The case has been escalated and the priority increased
The case needs attention or is waiting for input / review

questions.explanation: A red highlight on a Case's Action status field indicates the case is blocked by other tasks or waiting for customer feedback. Red signifies a blocking condition. Blue indicates 'Needs attention' which is less severe. Red does not indicate SLA breach, escalation, or a need for input/review specifically.

questions.stem: What is the purpose of a Case Task?

options.text: Case tasks are only used only for Cases that have a Service Definition
Case tasks document customer information on a Case
Case tasks are used to assign work to the customer
Case tasks document additional work that needs to be completed to resolve the Case

questions.explanation: A Case Task documents additional work that needs to be completed to resolve the case. Tasks break down complex cases into manageable work items that can be assigned to different agents or teams. They are not limited to cases with Service Definitions (A), do not document customer info (B), and are not assigned to customers (C).

questions.stem: Where should non-configurable attributes be stored?
questions.explanation: Non-configurable attributes should be stored in Product Model Tables. Product models define the specifications and attributes of products, and non-configurable (fixed) attributes belong on the product model. Case tables store case data, free text is unstructured, and contract tables store agreement information.

questions.stem: What feature allows an agent to provide updates to customers and internal stakeholders while a Case is in progress?
questions.explanation: Open Case Summary allows an agent to provide updates to customers and internal stakeholders while a case is in progress. It creates a structured summary of the current case status that can be shared. Post Case Reviews happen after closure, Case Action Summaries and Active Case Updates are not standard CSM features.

questions.stem: What actions should be prioritized when storing Product Models with similar non-configurable attributes? (Choose two.)

options.text: Group them in a baseline table
Create separate tables for each attribute
Modify each product's data model individually
Ensure attributes match those of existing tables

questions.explanation: When storing Product Models with similar non-configurable attributes: group them in a baseline table (A) to share common attributes, and ensure attributes match those of existing tables (E) to maintain consistency. Creating separate tables per attribute (C) and modifying each model individually (D) create unnecessary complexity. Using custom tables (B) is not the priority approach.

questions.stem: Which business model involves supporting an organization's private customers and their employees?
questions.explanation: B2B2C (Business-to-Business-to-Consumer) is the business model that involves supporting an organization's private customers and their employees. In this model, the service provider supports a business client (B2B) who in turn serves individual consumers (2C). B2B is business-only, B2C is direct consumer, B2B2B is chain of businesses.

questions.stem: What does it mean if you do not see the Selector when creating Case tasks?

options.text: No service-to-service relationship has been defined
No Case to case task relationship has been defined
No product to case task relationship has been defined
No customer to task relationship has been defined

questions.explanation: If you do not see the Selector when creating Case tasks, it means no service-to-service relationship has been defined. The Selector relies on service relationships that map services to task types. Without these relationships defined, the system cannot display the task selection options. Product, customer, and case relationships are not the blocking factor.

questions.stem: For an implementation supporting a business and its customers, which business model should be used?
questions.explanation: For an implementation supporting a business and its customers (consumers), the B2B2C model should be used. B2B2C means the service provider works with a business partner to serve end consumers. B2B is for business-only relationships, B2C is direct-to-consumer without a business intermediary, and B2B2B is a chain of businesses.

questions.stem: What role do customer data models play in Service CSM from a technical perspective?

options.text: They support the implementation of various business models
They facilitate integration with third-party systems
They define the pricing structure for services

questions.explanation: Customer data models play a technical role in supporting the implementation of various business models (B2B, B2C, B2B2C, etc.). The data model defines how accounts, contacts, consumers, partners, and households are structured and related, enabling different business model configurations. They are not about performance metrics, third-party integrations, or pricing.

questions.stem: Which business models serve an organization's private customers or workers for personal use? (Choose two.)
questions.explanation: Business models serving an organization's private customers or workers for personal use include: B2B2E/Business-to-Business-to-Employee (B) where a business serves another business's employees, and B2B2C/Business-to-Business-to-Consumer (D) where a business serves another business's consumers. B2B and multi-level B2B2B are business-only models, while B2C goes direct.

questions.stem: When an agent requires additional information from the customer to help solve the case, the case state is:
questions.explanation: When an agent requires additional information from the customer, the case state is 'Awaiting Info.' The agent clicks 'Request Info' which transitions the case from Open to Awaiting Info. When the customer responds, the case moves back to Open. There is no Paused, Info Req, or Waiting state in the standard CSM case lifecycle.

questions.stem: What does the case action status use to automatically determine the action status for Cases?
questions.explanation: The case action status uses Case flows to automatically determine the action status for cases. Flows evaluate conditions relating to the case's current state and related tasks to set the action status field (blocked, needs attention, etc.). Case task state, case state alone, and case SLA are inputs but flows are the determining mechanism.

questions.stem: How can customer service agents and managers manually set the Action status field for a Case?

options.text: Enable the Needs attention field on the Case form
Change the State to awaiting action

questions.explanation: To manually set the Action status field, agents and managers enable the 'Needs attention' field on the Case form. This is a manual override that sets the case action status to 'Needs attention' (blue dot). You cannot directly change the action status dropdown, and reopening a case or changing state does not manually set action status.

questions.stem: What are the types of units used in counting for entitlements in ServiceNow?
questions.explanation: The two types of units used in counting for entitlements in ServiceNow are Cases and Hours. Case-based entitlements track the number of support cases a customer can open, while hour-based entitlements track total support time. Incidents/Problems, Tasks/Projects, and Requests/Changes are ITSM concepts, not CSM entitlement units.

questions.stem: How are consumers related to households?

options.text: Household field on the Consumer record
Consumers are not related to Households

questions.explanation: Consumers are related to households via the Household field on the Consumer record. This field directly links a consumer to their household, enabling grouping of consumers who share common attributes like address. There is no separate Household Member table, Location table, or special mechanism - it is a simple reference field.

questions.stem: Why would a customer service manager system administrator create want tabs on a dashboard?

options.text: Reports must be categorized by role on each dashboard
To better organize reports and widgets, and make it easier to share widgets
Reports must be categorized by type on each dashboard
There's a finite number of widgets allowed per dashboard

questions.explanation: A customer service manager or system administrator creates tabs on a dashboard to better organize reports and widgets, and make it easier to share widgets. Tabs provide logical grouping of related reports and widgets for cleaner dashboard navigation. Reports are not required to be categorized by role (A) or type (C), and there is no finite widget limit per dashboard (D).

questions.stem: What action to be taken if the product has no configurable attributes?

options.text: Optimize data in the Install Base Item table
Create new child table for Install Base Item
Group into existing extended Install Base Item table
Store it in the baseline Install Base Item table

questions.explanation: If a product has no configurable attributes, it should be stored in the baseline Install Base Item table. The baseline table is designed for products without unique configurations. Creating child tables or new tables is only needed when products have distinct configurable attributes that require additional fields.

questions.stem: Which data model should be employed to track a household where group of consumers share a common address?
questions.explanation: To track a household where a group of consumers share a common address, the Household with Consumer data model should be employed. This model links consumers to a household entity via the Household field on the consumer record, with the household containing the shared address. Customer Access Management and Organizational models serve different purposes.

questions.stem: Which service catalogs are available in the base instance customer portals? (Choose two.)
questions.explanation: The two service catalogs available in the base instance customer portals are Consumer Service (A) and Customer Service (B). The Consumer Service catalog serves individual consumers while the Customer Service catalog serves business contacts. Partner Service and Product Service are not OOB portal service catalogs.

questions.stem: What is included in an account relationship record? (Choose three.)

options.text: The account relationship type that this relationship record is based on

questions.explanation: An account relationship record includes: the account relationship type that the record is based on (C), a target account (D), and a source account (E). These three elements define a relationship between two accounts using a defined relationship type. Primary contact and parent/child records are account fields, not relationship record components.

questions.stem: What attribute/field is employed to construct the hierarchy of Install Base Items in a system?
questions.explanation: The Parent Install Base Item field is used to construct the hierarchy of Install Base Items. This reference field links child install base items to their parent, building a tree structure. Configurable Attributes define item properties, and Root/Child Install Base Item are not standard ServiceNow field names for hierarchy building.

questions.stem: What should be done if an attribute about an Install Base item is merely for informational purposes?

options.text: Include it in the entitlement details
Track it as an Install Base characteristic
Document it in the product manual
Create an Install Base custom field

questions.explanation: If an attribute about an Install Base item is merely for informational purposes, it should be tracked as an Install Base characteristic. Characteristics store supplementary information about install base items without requiring table extensions. Entitlement details, product manuals, and custom fields are not the correct approach for informational attributes.
